description.sub_name: 全球趨勢與商務議題分析
description.sub_ename: GLOBAL TENDS AND INTERNATIONAL ISSUES ANALYSIS
description.describe_ch: 本課程主要教授國際趨勢與議題的解析，培養學生具有國際觀，並對於世界潮流與國際事務的議題具有分析、解讀能力。課程將探討趨勢議題與當前國際情勢對於國家產業與商務環境之影響，並引領學生對於國際趨勢與商務環境議題的關切。
description.describe_eh: This course is to analyze international trends and issues and to extend students' international view, and the ability to analyze and interpret global issues and international affairs. The course explores important global issues on the industry and business environment from managerial point of view. Students could encourage to concern international trends and business environment issues.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1. Attendance & Time Management
• 	Please arrive on time. 
• 	If you need to miss a session due to special circumstances, notify the instructor in advance via email or the ILEARN platform.
• 	Field visits and group activities are integral parts of the course and should be treated with equal importance.
2. Participation & Conduct
• 	Actively engage in discussions, group work, and feedback sessions. Respect diverse perspectives.
• 	Use electronic devices only for course-related purposes. Avoid distractions that may disrupt others.
• 	Audio or video recording is not permitted unless prior approval is obtained from the instructor.
3. Assignments & Deliverables
• 	Submit all assignments on time and in the required format. Late submissions may not be graded unless prior arrangements are made.
• 	If AI tools are used to support your work, please disclose how they were used and consider ethical implications.
4. Academic Integrity & Ethics
• 	Plagiarism, ghostwriting, data fabrication, and other forms of misconduct are strictly prohibited and will be handled according to university policy.
• 	Teamwork should reflect fair collaboration. Free-riding or misrepresentation of contributions is not acceptable.
5. Communication & Support
• 	If you have questions about course content, progress, or evaluation, feel free to reach out after class or via email.
• 	Open dialogue and creative thinking are encouraged—your ideas and suggestions are always welcome.
• 	Learning resources will be provided throughout the course.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Please come to the classroom on time. Teachers will start the class when the bell rings. 
Please actively participate in the discussion part of the class. 
You may bring your laptop or tablet, but please use it correctly to search and analyze the information.
All comments are welcome, but please be polite and respect others' comments.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
Do not copy and paste from any report and or website information. You should digest the data you collect and write the comments from your own language. 
Please correctly cite your references in your report. 
I'd like you to read the materials by yourself and write your comments about the materials.
Don't be a free-rider in your team; everyone should collaborate to complete the oral presentation and final projects.
If you use Gen AI to do your assignments, please provide prompts and indicate where do you apply Gen AI.
